scope: Read-only briefing associations with six existing river watch groups, nearby county road records and authorized connected assets. No source edits, AGOL changes or new dispatch / hazard thresholds.

method.briefings: GIS-maintained regional / headwater associations bound to exact reviewed PDF revisions; no NWS reach-specific forecasts or impact polygons inferred.
method.geometry: WGS84 points, polyline segments and polygon footprints; spherical minimum distance with mean radius 6371008.8 m, displayed approximately to 0.1 km. Multipart gaps and holes preserved. Invalid geometry accounted for once.
method.search: 1 / 5 / 10 km from listed gauge/dam points. Default 5 km is a lookup preference, not an action threshold, access route or complete river corridor.
method.timing: Published start/end Pacific calendar dates compared with current reviewed public briefing dates; incomplete / conflicting times stay unknown. Date intersection is not confirmation of simultaneous impacts.
method.privacy: Existing source permissions and sign-in control assets. Operational data remains in page memory; disconnect, denied access and sign-out clear asset copies in the new list and selected map context. No new persistence or external exports.

newCases: Spherical segment interiors, multipart gaps, polygon holes and invalid / projected geometry
Coarse spatial pruning agrees with complete local distances
Stable-ID deduplication and independence from topic filters / map extent
Search distances do not become hazard / travel-time thresholds
Inactive history and elapsed active flags stay distinct from reopening
Failed or stale feeds and incomplete geometry remain qualified
Disconnected authorization excludes private records even if a stale caller supplies them
Calendar overlap, missing dates and contradictory windows
Dated / past / stale briefings cannot create a current combined context cue

browserLocal: Six groups display source evidence and source-page links
County road query loads; three nearby records cross-checked against existing status/detail dialogs with full years
Existing authorized county facility inventory loaded; nearby asset records appeared with source owner/status and unknown backup-power qualification
Selected map draws reference points, nearby roads and loaded assets without a hazard-area buffer

limits: Regional associations need county / operator confirmation
Reference-point proximity does not establish exposure, a facility access route, capacity or an approved staging site
Upstream snow context does not predict snow at lower gauges or nearby assets
Older county road records have unresolved status and remain verification context
Only loaded authorized inventories are assessed; pump / generator schemas and Enterprise access remain existing prerequisites
No resource allocation, dispatch, modeled river arrival or predicted inundation
